running_case: Recycling MDP of slide 8: cells 1-5, start 2, terminal 1 (+2) and 5 (+10), +1 on entering 4, actions left/right, gamma = 0.9, three-minute deadline. Solved by backward planning (Table 1, Propositions 1-2), augmented with n_left (Figure 2, Table 2), learned by a one-hot linear Q-network (Proposition 3, code), varied in exercises 1-3. The slide-33 three-action example carries exploration; a three-response example carries the RLHF optimum.
